parameters.query:
SELECT a.*, s.phase_key, s.theme, s.goal, s.status AS slot_status, c.name AS client_name, c.archetype, c.archetype_traits, c.adversary, c.brand_goal, c.tone_of_voice, c.writing_guide
FROM articles a
JOIN content_slots s ON s.id = a.slot_id
JOIN clients c ON c.id = s.client_id
WHERE a.slot_id = $1
ORDER BY a.id DESC
LIMIT 1
INSERT INTO article_feedback (id, slot_id, article_id, reviewer_name, feedback_type, comment, action_label, excerpt, status) VALUES (UUID(), $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, 'open')
UPDATE articles SET status = 'feedback' WHERE slot_id = $1

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, slot_id: $('Validate Article').item.json.slot_id, status: 'feedback', feedback_count: $('Insert Feedback').all().length }) }}
